name: Fey
gmNotes: Fey means an actual alien individual — an Elgafar, plural Elgafari, though those technical terms are reserved for rare deep lore. Actual Fey are small six-limbed beings with head spiracles, tabby two-coloured skin, alien sustenance, iron toxicity, aesthetic cognition, and a physical inability to make knowingly false assertions. Their apparent height, clothing, breathing apparatus, glamour, and Fashion communicate rank. Fey kinds such as Lepracaun, Banshee, Pooka, Brownie, and Leannán Sidhe are roles, functions, training, patterns, or social identities — Archetypes, not biological Species. Clones, Takelings, and Changelings are Human, not Fey. Consult the searchable Fey GM dossiers for authoritative biology, culture, and technology; do not expose their protected lore in player-facing narration.
description: The Fair Folk of old stories — beautiful, strange, and bound by their own courtesy. They come out of the hollow hills and fairy rings. The village calls them the Aos Sí, and no one agrees on what they want.
